Doors only, no drawers (F-32 does not apply); a door opened while the right-hand chairs are occupied meets a chair back. Product details: "10 year guarantee." "The doors open with a light push and close silently and softly, as the hinges have both push-open and soft-closing functions." "Adjustable shelves, so you can customize your storage as needed." Good to know: "The max load for a wall-hung frame depends on the wall material." "BESTÅ suspension rails for wall mounting are included." "3 adjustable shelves included." Holds table linens, placemats, candles and Maddie's crayons and paper; at 8 5/8" deep it does not take 10" dinner plates. Solid ash-veneer doors on a white frame (the house style's white and light wood), no glass, no handles to bump into.
